summary.text: Rosemarie Rung is a Democratic state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 12 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a public affairs and communications manager by profession.

paragraphs.text: Rosemarie Rung graduated from Nashua High School and earned a B.S. in biochemistry from the University of New Hampshire in 1980, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as a communications manager and public affairs leader at Dow Chemical and as a corporate and learning development professional for Hewlett-Packard.
Rung served on the Merrimack School Board and as president of the Yankee chapter of the Public Relations Society of America.
Ballotpedia lists Rung's House tenure as beginning in 2018, and she has represented Hillsborough 12 since the 2022 election.
She was assigned to the Resources, Recreation and Development Committee for the 2019-2020 and 2023-2024 sessions.
